title: Release notes on the first start after an upgrade (/whats-new)
behavior: After upgrading the package, the first interactive pi start shows what changed since the version you last ran, once; later starts stay silent, and /whats-new shows those notes again on demand.
hint: Start pi twice in a row: the first start shows "pi-toolkits updated X → Y", the second does not. `/whats-new` re-shows the notes, `/whats-new all` lists every bundled release, `/whats-new off` silences the startup notice.

title: Permission parser: approval-log false positives 52 → 16
behavior: Routine read-only commands — grep with quoted regexes, literal for-loops over files, env pipelines, docker ps and curl with -w — no longer stop for an approval, while unresolved outputs, sudo and arbitrary code still do.
hint: In a session with /ask-perm on: `grep -n '\s*$' `, `for f in a b; do grep -n x "$f"; done`, `env | grep PI_`, `curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' http://localhost/` and `docker ps` should run without a dialog; `echo x > "$UNKNOWN"` and `sudo …` still ask.

title: Startup-only release notes and permission safety review fixes
behavior: An upgrade shows its release notes once on the next interactive start without adding any slash command, and shell variables or unresolved redirects that cannot be judged safely now keep asking instead of risking an allow.
hint: Start pi twice after an upgrade: the first shows the notes and the second is silent; there is no /whats-new command. With permission enabled, conditional/reassigned shell variables and unresolved redirects should still ask.

title: 发版等待：registry 改走 HTTP 探测、进度分阶段、排队卡死的 run 自动补发
behavior: 发版时等待 CI 的那一段现在会分阶段打印进度（run 未出现 / 排队 / 运行中 / CI 已绿、等 npm 传播），并且卡在排队、迟迟不开始的 run 会自动补发一次 workflow_dispatch，不再需要人工 gh workflow run 救援。
hint: 下次发版时看这一段输出：应依次出现「workflow run 还没出现 / CI queued / CI in_progress / CI 已绿…等 registry 传播」，每行带 t=Ns。想看补发，把 PI_RELEASE_RESCUE_QUEUE_MS 设成比正常排队更小的值（如 3000）再发一版，会看到「⚠ run … 排队 Xs 仍未开始 —— 补发 workflow_dispatch」与「↳ 已接管新的 run …」。

title: quit-guard: 三层退出兜底 + arm 级心跳 watchdog 线程，修复 exit 路径死锁导致进程不死
behavior: 崔总退出 pi 时，即使宿主退出路径死锁（包括把事件循环一起卡死的深挂），quit-guard 也会在超时后由独立线程强制结束进程并写报告，终端可靠地回到 shell 提示符，不再出现关窗才能逃离的冻结画面。
hint: 装一个在 process.on("exit") 里 Atomics.wait 死锁的探针扩展，/quit 后 ~10s 进程应被杀且 tmux pane 回到 shell 提示符；对照组 /quit-guard off 时同一探针下进程永挂。

title: ask-init: framework parity, safe auto-refresh, and phase guards
behavior: Running `/ask-init` again now tells you whether the project's framework text matches the installed version, repairs missing or stale framework-owned files when safe, and says explicitly when nothing needs changing; ask/plan/UAT phases can no longer be stacked, and a hand-edited AGENTS.md example can no longer be mistaken for the managed workflow block.
hint: In a framework project, run `/ask-init` twice: the second run should report framework files current without a model turn. Run `/ask-init check` and look for the W-FW/I-FW/W-PATH codes. In a project without the framework, `/ask-uat` and `record_change` refuse with the missing list; `/ask` and `/ask-review` stay usable.

title: Review fixes for ask-init parity and phase integration
behavior: After the third-party review, framework refreshes now distinguish real hand edits from missing anchors, dry runs no longer tell the operator to reload, wrong-type framework paths are rejected, missing AGENTS.md is reported explicitly, and planning in a linked worktree checks the framework in the main checkout.
hint: Run /ask-init refresh --dry-run and verify there is no /reload reminder; create a linked worktree and start /ask-plan to verify it sees the main checkout's framework.

title: ask-spec: rename the browser review and rebuild the review page
behavior: The browser review is now `/ask-spec` (with `/ask-plan` still working), and its page shows a warm two-column layout with a revision/annotation rail and a bottom bar that puts the review controls on the left and the total note count in the middle.
hint: Run `/ask-spec <topic>` in a project, write and submit a spec, then open the review page: the header says Spec review, the right rail lists revision stats and clickable notes, and the footer has Only changed / Global notes on the left with the note count centered.

title: ask-spec review: fix rename compatibility and history errors
behavior: The spec review now clears legacy phase markers, keeps legacy histories visible during partial migrations, and no longer labels older revisions as latest.
hint: Switch to an older revision: the history summary shows only its block count, not “latest revision”. Legacy-store and marker behavior is covered by regression tests.

title: Remove plannotator extension and pen.dev/pencil CLI from the host
behavior: The operator now sees no plannotator in pi's package list, no `pen`/`pencil` commands in the shell, and only the paintress MCP server in pi, while the VS Code pencil extension keeps working untouched.
hint: `pi list | grep -i plannotator` prints nothing; in a fresh fish shell `type pen pencil` reports not found; `pi` still starts and its MCP tools list shows paintress only; the VS Code pencil extension (WSL window) still connects.

title: pi 1.6.0 host compatibility migration
behavior: After upgrading pi to 1.6.0 the plugin still loads and every feature works, and the README now states only the tested range (`pi >= 0.99.0`, verified through 1.6.0) instead of explaining our internal window/probe policy.
hint: Run `pnpm check:compat` and read the verdict block (window 1.3.0–1.6.0, probe 1.2–0.99, floor 0.99.0); open README.md and confirm the Requirements line and the contributor "Host compatibility" bullet mention only the floor and the verified range.
